opening.argument: The material is instructional in its substance: it demonstrates how Coinbase users buy and sell coins, manage payment methods, and navigate account functions. The walkthrough explains that users can add an account or credit card under payment settings, while the on-screen forms show the ordinary fields for buying and selling. It also addresses verification, fees, account limits, and transaction procedures. The description includes a Coinbase referral bonus and links to additional crypto services, but that promotion is accompanied by a warning to invest only what viewers can afford to lose and a disclaimer that the speaker gives no investment advice. Nothing presented guarantees profit or establishes a deceptive money or data-collection mechanism; the content remains consistent with platform promotion and operational education.
